name: Giving & Generosity
overview: Scripture teaches that giving and generosity are acts of stewardship entrusted by God, who commands His people to honor Him through offerings and tithes. From the earliest times, as seen in Genesis, believers are called to dedicate a tenth of their blessings back to God, acknowledging His provision and sovereignty. The tithe is described as holy and belonging to the Lord, emphasizing that all resources ultimately come from Him and are to be managed with faithfulness and reverence.
